name: Input Buffer
description: Forgives early clicks by holding them for a few physics ticks, with a live status overlay.

cycle-keybind.name: Cycle Stage
cycle-keybind.description: Cycles Off -> Stage 1 -> Stage 2 -> Stage 3 while in a level. Applies to the very next input, no restart needed.

remember-stage.name: Remember Stage
remember-stage.description: Start each session on the stage you last used instead of Off.

windows-title.name: Buffer Windows
windows-title.description: How many physics ticks (240 per second) an early click is held for at each stage.

stage1-ticks.name: Stage 1 (Subtle)
stage1-ticks.description: Forgives clicks released 1-2 ticks too early.

stage2-ticks.name: Stage 2 (Moderate)
stage2-ticks.description: Forgives clicks released a few ticks too early.

stage3-ticks.name: Stage 3 (Showcase)
stage3-ticks.description: Very forgiving. Meant for debugging and demonstrating the buffer.

flight-title.name: Ship / Wave / Swing
flight-title.description: In these modes the buffer simulates your path ahead of time. If sending a click or release right now would crash you almost immediately, it's held back to the nearest tick (within the stage window) where the path survives.

flight-enabled.name: Flight Buffer
flight-enabled.description: Delay ship, wave and swing inputs that would crash you within the reaction margin.

flight-margin.name: Reaction Margin
flight-margin.description: Only step in when an input would crash you within this many ticks (240 per second). Crashes further out are left for you to steer around.

flight-lookahead.name: Look-ahead
flight-lookahead.description: How many ticks a delayed input must keep you alive to count as fully safe. Higher picks safer timings but simulates more when a crash is detected.

log-lines.name: Log Lines
log-lines.description: How many recent saves the overlay lists (0 shows just the header and stats).

show-expired.name: Log Unused Buffers
show-expired.description: Also log early clicks that were held for the whole window but never turned into an action.

hide-when-off.name: Hide When Off
hide-when-off.description: Hide the overlay while the buffer is Off. It always shows while a stage is active.

console-log.name: Console Telemetry
console-log.description: Mirror every save and stage change to the Geode console / log file.
